title: Entity growth batch 04 — group C
notes: Breadth-first candidate group for Issue #203. Sollet and Slope were rejected for insufficient first-party lifecycle boundaries; later duplicate checks also rejected Cake Wallet, OneKey Wallet, and Blockstream App as already-canonical identities. They are replaced here by Taho, Sequence, and Nightly. Canonical publication prohibited until validation and manual review complete.

entities.summary: Non-custodial Solana wallet ecosystem distributed as browser extensions and mobile applications.
entities.notes: Current first-party Glow developer documentation explicitly calls Glow non-custodial and separates extension, iOS and Android surfaces. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Community-owned open-source self-custodial Web3 wallet lineage originally launched as Tally Ho and renamed Taho in 2023.
entities.notes: First-party history says Tally Ho launched in 2021 and was renamed Taho on 2023-02-21. Current first-party security material says private keys remain on the user's computer.

entities.summary: Non-custodial smart-wallet ecosystem using programmable multi-key smart-contract wallets for standalone and embedded Web3 access.
entities.notes: Current first-party support documentation describes Sequence Wallet as non-custodial and distinguishes Universal Wallet from Embedded Wallet. Initial wallet launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Multichain software wallet distributed as browser extensions and mobile applications with user-controlled encrypted wallet keys.
entities.notes: First-party launch post introduced Nightly Wallet on 2022-07-04. Current first-party security and FAQ material says private keys are encrypted and the wallet can be restored with the user's secret phrase.

entities.summary: Non-custodial Bitcoin and Layer 2 mobile wallet operated by JAN3, supporting Bitcoin, Liquid, Lightning-related flows and USDt integrations.
entities.notes: AQUA first-party terms identify JAN3 LLC and describe AQUA as non-custodial. It is modeled separately from Blockstream Jade and other Blockstream wallet lineages. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.notes: Selected browser-extension runtime only; iOS and Android products are deferred.

products.summary: Current Taho self-custodial browser-extension wallet, preserving the earlier Tally Ho wallet lineage.
products.notes: First-party Taho history says Tally Ho launched in 2021; exact initial public release day is not asserted. Current download page lists Chrome and Brave.

products.summary: Standalone Sequence smart wallet for managing assets and connecting to external Web3 applications.
products.notes: Selected Universal Wallet boundary only. Sequence Embedded Wallet remains a separate product architecture and is deferred.

products.summary: Nightly multichain browser-extension wallet with device-encrypted private keys.
products.notes: Selected browser-extension runtime only; mobile applications are deferred. First-party launch post introduced the wallet on 2022-07-04, although Chrome-store distribution was still gated at that moment.

products.summary: AQUA non-custodial mobile Bitcoin and Layer 2 wallet application.
products.notes: Current first-party distribution lists App Store, Google Play and direct Android APK.

evidence.title: Glow Javascript SDK — About Glow
evidence.notes: First-party developer docs explicitly identify Glow as a non-custodial Solana wallet and list extension, iOS and Android surfaces.

evidence.title: Glow — Your New Favorite Solana Wallet
evidence.notes: Current official distribution page lists Glow desktop browser extensions separately from mobile applications.

evidence.title: Meet Taho, the first community-owned Web3 wallet
evidence.notes: First-party rebrand announcement states Tally Ho is now Taho and says the wallet lineage began in 2021.

evidence.title: Taho Security
evidence.notes: Current first-party security page states Taho is 100% self-custodial, private keys stay on the user's computer, and the browser wallet is currently downloadable.

evidence.title: The Sequence Wallets
evidence.notes: Current first-party support material describes Sequence Wallet as a non-custodial smart wallet and distinguishes Universal and Embedded wallet accounts.

evidence.title: Sequence Wallet security
evidence.notes: First-party security article states Sequence is non-custodial and cannot access wallet contents. The selected product is the standalone Universal Wallet rather than Embedded Wallet.

evidence.title: Hello World! Nightly Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party launch post introduced Nightly Wallet on 2022-07-04 as a multichain wallet and described the browser extension as the initial product surface.

evidence.title: Nightly Wallet Features
evidence.notes: Current first-party feature page lists browser-extension and mobile runtimes separately and states private keys are encrypted and never leave the device.

evidence.title: AQUA Wallet Terms of Service
evidence.notes: First-party terms identify JAN3 LLC and describe AQUA as a non-custodial Bitcoin and Layer 2 wallet.

evidence.title: Download AQUA
evidence.notes: Current first-party distribution page lists iOS, Google Play and direct Android APK for AQUA Wallet.
